name: li_pairmask
parts: lineitem: U64 pair masks, one per chunk of 2048 stored lineitem rows of facts: bit rf * 8 + ls is set for every (l_returnflag, l_linestatus) dictionary-code pair (rf, ls) occurring in the chunk (empty when a code is 8 or more)

layout.summary: facts unchanged (75 inherited parts), then one U64 part: per chunk of 2048 stored lineitem rows, the set of (l_returnflag, l_linestatus) code pairs present, as a 64-bit mask (bit rf_code * 8 + ls_code)
layout.units: bits indexed by rf_code * 8 + ls_code, codes being facts' sorted-dictionary indices; mask c covers stored lineitem rows [2048 c, 2048 c + 2048)
